name: Star Number of the Three-Code Class
proof: Projecting to $\{x_0,x_1\}$ gives $\{00,01,11\}$, with $01$ adjacent to both other traces, so the star number is at least two. No projection of a three-concept class has a vertex of degree above two. Hence $\mathrm S=2$; this is exhaustively checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition; compare the projected-star formulation in \cite{hanneke2015minimax}.
